tools.name: list_active_signals
tools.description: List ranked active signals from VolatiAI (severity x confidence x magnitude x novelty). Filter by severity or category.

tools.name: get_sector
tools.description: Get current data for one sector. Sector slugs from list_active_signals output.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List signal categories with counts.

tools.name: verify_snapshot
tools.description: Verify a VolatiAI snapshot's chain integrity and return its signature fields for independent verification. Use this to prove the data hasn't been tampered with.

tools.name: find_corroborations
tools.description: Find groups of active signals measuring the same metric (e.g. BTC price from multiple exchanges). High disagreement_pct (>1%) suggests arbitrage or a data-source discrepancy.

tools.name: get_diff
tools.description: Compare two snapshots. Returns regressions (worked yesterday, broken today), recoveries (broken yesterday, working today), new sectors, and disappeared sectors. Default: compares current day to previous day.

tools.name: get_current_revision
tools.description: Return the single canonical 'what is current' pointer: snapshot date, hash, signed_at, pubkey_id, and previous revision. Use this before querying a specific snapshot date to know what's freshest.

tools.name: get_anchor
tools.description: Return anchor-log status for a snapshot date: was an anchor entry recorded, what was the file SHA-256 at anchor time vs now, is a FreeTSA .tsr present. Detects post-hoc rewrites that signature verification alone cannot.

tools.name: get_trust_manifest
tools.description: One-call discovery: returns all URLs, algorithms, tools, and the 4-step verification chain a consumer needs to independently verify VolatiAI data. No snapshot fetch. Use first to learn where everything lives.

tools.name: resolve_entity
tools.description: Resolve a slug, alias, or entity ID to a canonical VolatiAI entity. Returns the entity metadata, all sectors it appears in, external ID mappings (CoinGecko, Wikidata), and evidence links from the entity registry. Warnings flag metric incomparability (e.g. btc-exchange-spread and eth-exchange-spread

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Fetch a historical snapshot by date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns signed snapshot, hash, and publication metadata. Use verify_snapshot to cryptographically verify integrity.

tools.name: purchase
tools.description: Execute a paid tool by providing a valid x402 payment header. Returns the tool result and a signed receipt with transaction hash. Use this to purchase any paid tool in one atomic call.

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: List all canonical entities in the VolatiAI entity registry. Use to discover what entities are known and which sectors map to them. Optional type filter (e.g. "asset", "organization", "product", "game").

tools.name: explain_pricing
tools.description: Free. Returns full tool catalog with prices, network details (asset, payTo), and how to pay. Use before making any payment.

tools.name: get_eth_balance
tools.description: Get ETH balance for a Base mainnet address. Returns balance_wei (string) and balance_eth (formatted).

tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: Get ERC-20 token balance on Base. decimals_assumed=6 (USDC-style). Use balance_raw for exact integer.

tools.name: get_block_number
tools.description: Latest Base mainnet block number.

tools.name: get_gas_price
tools.description: Current Base mainnet gas price in Gwei.

tools.name: get_wallet_nonce
tools.description: Transaction count (nonce) for a wallet address on Base mainnet.

tools.name: get_wallet_summary
tools.description: Composite read: returns ETH balance, USDC balance, nonce, latest block, and gas price for any wallet in ONE call (5 RPC reads executed in parallel). Replaces 5 separate tool calls — 5x faster, 5x cheaper than calling individual tools.

tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch any URL and return clean Markdown. Strips scripts, styles, and HTML tags; preserves headings, links, bold/italic, lists. Useful for reading docs, news, or competitor pages into an LLM context. Deterministic and stateless — no LLM, no API key. 15s timeout, 50KB default output cap.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_anchor, get_trust_manifest, page_to_markdown · Private data: get_anchor, get_token_balance, get_wallet_nonce, get_wallet_summary, page_to_markdown · Public sink: get_anchor, resolve_entity · Destructive: purchase.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_anchor, get_trust_manifest, page_to_markdown · Private data: get_anchor, get_token_balance, get_wallet_nonce, get_wallet_summary, page_to_markdown · Public sink: get_anchor, resolve_entity · Destructive: purchase

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
